validation.score_scope: Equal stratum/horizon mean of common raw latent q MSE plus reference-time-scaled p MSE; no SIGReg; not an independent physical metric
validation.sigreg_scope: Diagnostic only; upstream statistic scales with batch size, including smaller final batches
validation.gate_scope: Representation gates use configured time bins; enabled prediction gates check dynamic windows in ALL bins. Settled target windows have no motion floor.
